## Checklist

- [ ] It fits the PlayGlaze look (glossy, chunky, 3D lip, colors from `tone()`).
- [ ] Drawn in code only — no image files, no art copied from paid kits.
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies.
- [ ] Colors come from a `color` prop or the theme.
- [ ] Props are typed and have sensible defaults.

- [ ] Tested on the web docs; on iOS / Android if it touches native behavior.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
